name: plot2data
description: Client-side extraction of numerical data from images of plots

scripts.build: npm run assets && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node --experimental-strip-types tools/inline-bundle.ts
scripts.build:android: npm run assets && tsc --noEmit && P2D_ANDROID=1 vite build && node --experimental-strip-types tools/sync-android-assets.ts
scripts.build:review: npm run assets && tsc --noEmit && P2D_SINGLE=1 vite build && node --experimental-strip-types tools/single-file.ts
scripts.accuracy: npm run assets && vitest run test/accuracy.test.ts --reporter=verbose
